roster.name: ENA / SRA submission XML/JSON schema (SRA.submission.xsd and related XSDs)
roster.description: The ENA/SRA submission metadata schema used for programmatic submissions (XML or JSON). Defines the structure and fields for submission-level and object-level metadata (submission, study, sample, experiment, run, analysis and project) via SRA.*.xsd and ENA.project.xsd, and is used with Webin REST V2/Webin-CLI for uploading and validating sequence data and associated metadata.

roster.name: ENA Sequence Data Classes (controlled vocabulary)
roster.description: The ENA-defined classification/vocabulary of sequence data classes (e.g., reads, assembly, annotation domain and specific classes such as EST, GSS, STS, CON, TSA, HTC, HTG, STD, PAT, WGS). Describes what each class represents, expected content and available export formats (EMBL/TEXT, FASTA), used to categorize sequence records in ENA.
